headline: Brazilian stocks tumble as Lula election victory triggers trading halt
summary: The Ibovespa index plunged following Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva's presidential election victory over Flavio Bolsonaro, triggering a 30-minute trading suspension on the Sao Paulo Stock Exchange.
why: Investors closely monitor presidential elections in Latin America's largest economy due to fiscal policy and regulatory changes.

impacts.name: Ibovespa Index
impacts.why: Investor concern over leftist fiscal policies triggered immediate stock sell-offs.

why_moved: Political uncertainty and fears of increased public spending under Lula caused panic selling in Brazilian equities.
